items.title: David Spinozza interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, NY, September 27, 2025
items.q: Dr. John was in the mixing room... 'Man we forgot to put a sax solo on this tune. Can you come and play a little solo for me?' ... I go in the mix room... I play the solo

ctx.x: Have you ever had a solo that came out that had been “put together.” Like you did three or four and then the producer –
Oh yeah, some. Yeah. The one solo I did that didn’t get put together but it’s a weird thing I don't know if you heard the Dr. John story. Do you know that story? Would you like me to tell it?
